parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name of which you want to verify the ownership. You can specify only one domain name.

parameters.name: VerifyType
parameters.description:
The verification method. Valid values:

*   **dnsCheck**: by DNS record
*   **fileCheck**: by verification file

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn verify-domain-owner --domain-name example.com --verify-type dnsCheck --region cn-hangzhou
